steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.endTour?.(); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setLocation?.({ lat: 1.3521, lon: 103.8198, label: 'SG' }); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setQualityTier?.('high'); })()

steps.name: set-door-double
steps.eval: (() => { const st=window.__store.getState(); const fp=st.floorPlan; const door=fp.openings.find(o=>o.kind==='door'); if (door) st.updateOpening(door.id,{style:'double',material:'wood',width:Math.max(door.width,1.2)}); return door ? door.id : null; })()

steps.name: camera-at-door
steps.eval: (() => { const st=window.__store.getState(); const fp=st.floorPlan; const door=fp.openings.find(o=>o.kind==='door'); const wall=fp.walls.find(w=>w.id===door.wallId); const len=Math.hypot(wall.end[0]-wall.start[0],wall.end[1]-wall.start[1]); const ux=(wall.end[0]-wall.start[0])/len, uz=(wall.end[1]-wall.start[1])/len; const cx=wall.start[0]+ux*(door.offset+door.width/2), cz=wall.start[1]+uz*(door.offset+door.width/2); const c=window.__three.controls; const cam=window.__three.camera; cam.position.set(cx-uz*3.0+ux*0.4, 1.7, cz+ux*3.0+uz*0.4); c.target.set(cx, 1.0, cz); c.update(); return [cx,cz]; })()

steps.name: door-open
steps.eval: (() => { const st=window.__store.getState(); const fp=st.floorPlan; const door=fp.openings.find(o=>o.kind==='door'); st.toggleDoor(door.id); return door.id; })()
